title: Total Carbohydrate Content for Coral Samples
author: Keyla Plichon

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary stock solutions for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a D-glucose standard stock solution with a final concentration of 2 g/L using the same buffer solution used for tissue homogenate; store at 4°C in the dark.
Prepare a 5% phenol stock solution by diluting phenol in MilliQ water; store at 4°C.
Prepare a stock of concentrated (100%) sulfuric acid and keep it at room temperature.

steps.title: Set Up Water Bath
steps.instruction: Prepare the heating environment under a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Set the water bath (or a heating plate with a glass water container) to 90°C.
Ensure there is sufficient water to heat the wells evenly without the plate sinking.

steps.title: Prepare Standard Range
steps.instruction: Set up the glucose standard curve in a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 μL of the glucose stock solution directly into the wells.
Bring the final volume of each well to 30 μL (resulting in concentrations of 0, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24 μg).

steps.title: Prepare Coral Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare and load the coral homogenate samples into the 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a dilution of the homogenate with a known protein amount for normalization (for Pocillopora sp. and Porites sp., the final protein concentration in each well was 0.1 μg/μL).
Add 30 μL of sample to each well in triplicates, designating one well as a blank for each sample.
If necessary, prepare several dilutions of unknown samples to ensure readings fall within the standard range.

steps.title: Perform Acid Hydrolysis
steps.instruction: React the samples with concentrated sulfuric acid.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 μL of concentrated sulfuric acid to each well and mix by pipetting.
Cover the plate and protect it from light.
Incubate the reaction for 15 min in the 90°C water bath.

steps.title: Add Phenol Reagent
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction and develop the color.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate from the water bath and allow it to reach room temperature.
Add 30 μL of Milli-Q water to the blank wells.
Add 30 μL of 5% phenol solution to the duplicate wells, mixing well.
Incubate the plate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Quantify the carbohydrate content using a spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Mix the well contents using a multi-pipette or a plate shaker.
